name: Project Gutenberg
description: A volunteer library of over 70,000 free ebooks, mostly older works whose copyright has expired.
how_it_works: The app searches a copy of the Project Gutenberg catalog and opens each book from gutenberg.org.
how_to_access: Visit gutenberg.org to browse by title, author or subject and download books in many formats.

name: LibriVox
description: Free public domain audiobooks read by volunteers from around the world.
how_it_works: The app searches the LibriVox catalog and plays chapters directly from the Internet Archive.
how_to_access: Visit librivox.org to browse recordings, subscribe to podcasts or volunteer as a reader.

name: DOAB
description: DOAB, the Directory of Open Access Books, lists peer-reviewed open access academic books, free to read and share.
how_it_works: The app searches DOAB and opens a book's PDF where one is available, usually from the OAPEN Library.
how_to_access: Visit directory.doabooks.org to search academic books by subject, publisher or language.

name: Open Library
description: An open catalog of every book, with millions of titles you can borrow digitally.
how_it_works: The app searches Open Library and links to its page, where you can read or borrow a book.
how_to_access: Visit openlibrary.org, sign in for free, and borrow digital copies for a limited time.

name: HathiTrust
description: A partnership of research libraries with millions of digitized books; the app lists those anyone can read.
how_it_works: The app searches a copy of HathiTrust's catalog. Each book opens in HathiTrust's reader in your web browser.
how_to_access: Visit hathitrust.org to search the full collection. Reading public-domain books needs no account.
